description: Crispy-bottomed, custardy coconut-rice cakes cooked in a dimpled pan.
descriptionKm: នំគ្រក — នំទឹកដូងស្រួយ ខាងក្នុងទន់ ដុតក្នុងថាសសម្បក។

ingredients.itemKm: ស្លឹកខ្ទឹមបារាំង

instructions.text: Whisk rice flour, coconut milk, a little sugar and salt into a batter.
Heat a num krok pan and oil the wells.
Fill the wells and cook until the bottoms crisp and tops set.
Top with spring onion; serve warm in pairs.
